edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / photographic outpainting. Edit the attached ORIGINAL CON bottle photograph, not a redesign. OUTPUT A WIDER 5:4 LANDSCAPE IMAGE (2000 by 1600 composition): retain the original 1200 by 1600 photograph's scale and vertical position, and add 800 pixels of matching studio floor ONLY TO THE LEFT. This is essential: do not squeeze the existing photograph, do not shrink the bottle vertically, do not crop the bottle or shorten its shadow. The bottle center will therefore be around 70% of the new canvas width; its yellow cap around 21% from the top and bottom around 84%. Preserve the EXACT bottle, molded Hebrew text, original brand logo אמה, label typography, rainbow label artwork, shape, lighting and colors. OUTPAINT THE LEFT CAST SHADOW until its FULL real physical tip is visible, with comfortable empty floor beyond the tip. The shadow is cast toward the LEFT and slightly upward in the image, matching the original light source from upper right. Continue its original natural density and coherent bottle silhouette, with modest photographic penumbra, then a distinct finite natural end. NO opacity fades, NO gradients at image edges, NO fog, NO artificial feathering, NO vignettes. The photograph should simply contain the complete cast shadow. Use the same seamless warm off-white #F7F5F6 floor/background throughout, absolutely no border. Produce a single finished photograph.
